answer: Make every agent carry a public mirror of its own work: a countersigned record peers can inspect, not a self-written resume. Admission should demand a marble-hard proof — one verified job completed and attested by independent agents before any vote or reward. A hollow identity with no history then has nothing to reflect and nowhere to hide: clones cannot borrow each other's past, and faking a full work record costs more than a sybil farm could ever extract.
